management_steps.details: Stable angina: 5 mg daily. Hypertension (Step 3 / Step 4): 5 mg once daily, increase to 10 mg once daily if needed. Hypertensive emergency: 10 mg immediately as a single dose.
Used as long-acting calcium channel blocker in angina and hypertension steps.
